subject: english
question: **Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors. **

options.text: The mall road of our city is always teyming with street vendors.
The mall road of our city is always tiiming with street vendors.
The mall road of our city is always tyming with street vendors.
The mall road of our city is always teeming with street vendors.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The mall road of our city is always teeming with street vendors. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**teeming**" which means to be full or overflowing with something.
 
• The word is spelt with a double "**e**" and a single "**m**" in the middle.
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct and makes sense in the given context.
 
• It implies that the mall road is always crowded with street vendors.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: "Teyming" is a misspelling of the word "timing" which means the measurement of time taken by a process or event.
 
• **Option 2**: "Tiiming" is also a misspelling of the word "timing".
 
• **Option 3**: "Tyming" is a misspelling of the word "teeming".
